sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Indoor blower motor temperature is too high. The motor tripped on its internal protector.
causes: Motor tripped on its internal protector
Motor bearings or amps out of range
diySteps: Turn the furnace off and make sure return and supply grilles are open. Do not reach into the blower housing
Technician: check motor bearings and amps, and replace the motor if necessary. The code clears after the blower demand is satisfied
proAdvice: E295 is a blower over-temperature trip. The manual does not name a dirty filter in this row. E291 is the airflow-restriction lockout that does. If E295 returns, call a licensed HVAC technician.
